title: Recorded exploratory checks and exposure counts
status: Public derivative of accepted historical internal evidence; not a new study analysis or new scientific review.

historical_source.role: Original record identity, not a resolvable public evidence path

public_evidence_note: This JSON is the exported evidence record. Its final exported path and matching SHA-256 are recorded by the release claim registry and artifact manifest, outside this file to avoid checksum cycles.
limits: The checks below are exploratory or post hoc and were performed outside the pinned analysis tools. They do not replace the preregistered primary analysis or its error model.

Raw per-map batch outputs, test-map manifests and per-update training logs are omitted. This record permits inspection of the accepted recorded values, not independent reconstruction from those omitted inputs.
Spinner completions and failures describe the simulator rules. Generated fidelity traces do not validate missed slider ticks, missed slider tails or spinner misses against the game engine.
No new experiment, training, sealed-pool read or audit run was performed to make this derivative.

spinner_post_hoc.classification: post hoc descriptive counts on T_ID; not a preregistered spinner test
spinner_post_hoc.exact_source_excerpt:
failures F, failures on spinner-drill maps, spinners completed of 799): `pd_n16_r1` 6,036 / 176 / 773;
  `pd_n16_r2` 4,193 / 343 / 324; `pd_n16_r3` 5,447 / 499 / 167; `pd_n256_r1` 764 / 231 / 411; `pd_n256_r2` 1,206 / 390
  / 76; `pd_n256_r3` 1,431 / 412 / 27; `pd_n4096_r1` 274 / 9 / 799; `pd_n4096_r2` 1,068 / 358 / 123; `pd_n4096_r3`
  1,108 / 367 / 109. Completed spinners fell from 16 to 256 maps and rose from 256 to 4,096 maps in every replicate.
  Spinner-drill maps hold 349 of `pd_n4096_r1`'s 794-failure advantage over r2 and 358 of 834 over r3 (lens 2's figures,
  consistent with these counts).
spinner_post_hoc.interpretation: Completed spinners fell from 16 to 256 maps and rose from 256 to 4096 maps in every replicate. Replicate 1 at 4096 maps alone completed all 799 spinners. Spinner-drill maps account for nearly half of its failure advantage over the other 4096-map runs, and it still leads on the remaining maps. Improvement at 4096 maps is mostly, not only, through replicate 1.

exposure.classification: descriptive exposure limitation; not an additional treatment or confirmatory test
exposure.interpretation: At the fixed budget, each map received thousands of clips with 16 maps, hundreds with 256 maps and about twenty with 4096 maps. Total notes played per run differed by several percent. The design does not separate diversity from reduced repetition per map.
